steps.npc: Welcome to Frankie's Fish Emporium, what can I do for you mate?

options.text: What have you got for sale?

steps.player: What have you got for sale?

steps.npc: We serve the finest fresh fish Piscarilius has to offer.

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.npc: I trade the finest fish in Piscarilius. In this city you get two choices, fishing or thuggery. I've kept afloat without resorting to the latter, not something which can be said by many of the folk around here.
